plan: In a first-price sealed bid auction with independent private values, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly less than my true value. My value is $22. I'll aim to bid just under my true value to increase my chances of winning while minimizing overpayment. A bid around $20-$21 seems strategic.

I'll bid around $33-$34 to maximize my chances of winning while ensuring potential positive earnings.
